news.title: Lodha Developers H1FY27 net profit soars 63%, expects to beat full-year guidance
news.summary: Lodha Developers reported a 63% rise in first-half FY27 profit to Rs 2,386 crore, driven by strong property sales and market expansion. The developer expects to exceed annual profit guidance while pursuing data centres to boost recurring income.

news.title: Spandana Sphoorty returns to profit at Rs 18 crore in Q2FY27
news.summary: Spandana Sphoorty Financial reported consolidated Q2 profit of Rs 18 crore, reversing a Rs 249 crore year-ago loss. Assets under management grew 31% to Rs 5,364 crore, while improving asset quality reduced gross and net NPAs.

news.title: Bank of Baroda Q2 profit jumps 36% to Rs 6,532 crore on NSE stake sale
news.summary: Bank of Baroda reported 36% year-on-year profit growth to Rs 6,532 crore in Q2FY27, boosted by NSE stake sale gains and higher interest income. The lender raised annual credit and deposit growth guidance amid strong loan demand.

news.title: Record earnings! 5 big takeaways from RIL Q2 results investors should watch for Monday trading
news.summary: Reliance Industries reported record Q2FY27 profit of Rs 29,550 crore and revenue of Rs 3.62 lakh crore, driven by strong refining margins and Jio growth. Retail profitability weakened, while declining debt improved the conglomerate's financial position.

news.title: Reliance Industries announces fundraising, to raise Rs 15,000 crore through NCDs
news.summary: Reliance Industries has approved plans to raise up to Rs 15,000 crore through non-convertible debentures via private placement. The fundraising announcement came with the company's Q2 earnings where it reported a 41% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 25,548 crore.

news.title: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Profit shoots up 41% YoY to Rs 25,548 crore, revenue surges 29%
news.summary: Reliance Industries Q2 Results: Mukesh Ambani-led Reliance Industries Ltd (RIL) on Friday reported a 41% year-on-year (YoY) growth in consolidated net profit to Rs 25,548 crore for the September quarter of FY27, compared with Rs 18,165 crore in the corresponding period last year.

news.title: Jio Platforms Q2 Results: Profit rises 14% YoY to Rs 8,389 crore; revenue up 11%
news.summary: Jio Q2 Results: Jio Platforms reported a 14% year-on-year rise in net profit to Rs 8,389 crore in Q2 FY27, its first results after listing. Revenue grew 11% to Rs 40,475 crore, supported by subscriber additions, growth in digital services and a marginal increase in ARPU.

news.title: NTPC Green Energy Q2 Results: Profit jumps 56% YoY to Rs 137 crore, revenue rises 53%
news.summary: NTPC Green Energy reported a 56.2% year-on-year rise in Q2FY27 net profit to Rs 137.5 crore, driven by 53.2% revenue growth. EBITDA margins improved, while new solar capacity boosted its operational renewable energy portfolio.

news.title: Vijay Kedia's portfolio stock under ₹150: This textile stock adds ₹3.7 crore to his wealth since IPO; Do you own?
